_comment: Map EVENT nodes are DATA (CLAUDE.md §11). Each event offers choices with immediate effects. Effect keys: heal (int, negative = a bruise — events never kill, HP floors at 1), max_hp (int, permanent), relic (bool, a random team relic), gold (int, into the shared purse), reward ('card'|'relic' — routes into the normal pick-1-of-3 screen), remove_card (bool, each hunter loses one random card from their own deck, never below MIN_DECK), sharpen_card (bool, each hunter upgrades one random un-upgraded card in their own deck, no-op if none), curse_card (a status-card id from cards.json, e.g. 'bruised_grip' — each hunter's deck gains one copy; unlike remove/sharpen this always fires, never a coin flip, since the whole point of a status card is you don't get to opt out — backlog #27), potion (a potion id from potions.json — each hunter with an open slot gets a copy, quietly capped like a fight's own drop), random_potion (bool, same as potion but rolled from the pool, same shape 'relic' rolls one), take_potion (bool, the gamble — each hunter loses one random HELD potion, a no-op if they're carrying none — backlog #37). An empty effects block is a clean walk-away. Tone: small climbers in a big wild world.

napping_beast.title: A Napping Beast
napping_beast.text: Something enormous is asleep across the trail. Its breathing moves the grass like weather. Tufts of shed fur — strong as rope — are caught on the rocks around it.

choices.label: Tiptoe past
choices.result: You go the long way round — and find a dropped purse on the path.

choices.label: Harvest the fur
choices.result: You gather an armful of rope-fur. It stirs; a swatting paw catches you both.

hollow_log.title: The Hollow Log
hollow_log.text: A fallen trunk lies across a gully, big enough to walk inside. It is dry, quiet, and smells faintly of somebody else's supplies.

choices.label: Sleep a while
choices.result: You wake warm and unbothered.

choices.label: Rummage deeper
choices.result: Somebody cached their kit here and never came back for it.

fallen_climber.title: A Fallen Climber's Pack
fallen_climber.text: A pack sits neatly against a stone, straps fastened, as if its owner meant to come back. There are no tracks leading away.

choices.label: Take the gear
choices.result: Good rope, good hooks, and a purse they no longer need.

choices.label: Build them a cairn
choices.result: You stack stones until it looks like something. You feel steadier for it.

windy_ledge.title: The Windy Ledge
windy_ledge.text: A shelf of rock cuts straight across the cliff — hours saved. The wind comes off it in slabs, and the drop below has no bottom you can see.

choices.label: Take the shortcut
choices.result: You cross on your bellies. The wind takes skin and temper both — but the way ahead is clear.

choices.label: Go the safe way
choices.result: Longer, duller, whole.

berry_thicket.title: The Bright Thicket
berry_thicket.text: Berries, fat and improbably purple. One of you is certain they are food. One of you is certain they are a warning.

choices.label: Eat your fill
choices.result: Delicious. No consequences whatsoever, probably.

choices.label: Pocket them for later
choices.result: You ration them out over the next few days and feel the better for it.

friendly_beetle.title: A Very Large Beetle
friendly_beetle.text: It is the size of a cart, iridescent, and appears delighted to see you. It lowers its head hopefully.

choices.label: Accept the ride
choices.result: It carries you up three switchbacks and sets you down gently, thrumming.

choices.label: Study its shell
choices.result: The plating is jointed in a way you had not considered. You sketch it.

old_grapple_line.title: An Old Line
old_grapple_line.text: A grapple line hangs down the rock face, weathered pale. Somebody rigged this a long time ago, and rigged it well.

choices.label: Climb it
choices.result: It holds. Of course it holds. You still feel the rope creak the whole way.

choices.label: Salvage the hardware
choices.result: The line is done for, but the ironwork is beautiful.

hot_spring.title: A Steaming Pool
hot_spring.text: Water the temperature of a good bath, tucked between two boulders, going quietly about its business.

choices.label: Soak
choices.result: Every ache you had been ignoring makes itself known, then leaves.

choices.label: Fill the flasks
choices.result: It stays warm for days. You will be glad of it later.

watchers_cairn.title: The Watcher's Cairn
watchers_cairn.text: A stack of flat stones, taller than either of you, worn smooth by hands. Small offerings are tucked into its gaps — hooks, teeth, a child's carving of something enormous.

choices.label: Leave an offering
choices.result: You add one of your own hooks. The wind drops for a moment.

choices.label: Take one
choices.result: You pocket a tooth the length of your forearm. It seems like a fair trade to you.

lost_cub.title: Something Small and Lost
lost_cub.text: It is unmistakably a baby version of something you will eventually have to fight. Right now it is stuck under a rock and crying about it.

choices.label: Free it
choices.result: It headbutts your shins in thanks and bounds off. You feel obscurely better about everything.

choices.label: Leave well alone
choices.result: You walk on. Its mother passes you an hour later, and does not look at you twice.

rockslide_altar.title: A Rockslide Altar
rockslide_altar.text: The slide unearthed a ring of stones nobody built this high by accident. Something is wedged in the middle, glinting.

choices.label: Dig it free
choices.result: The stones shift as you pull it loose. Worth it.

choices.label: Leave it buried
choices.result: You give the pile a wide berth and catch your breath instead.

stranded_kite.title: A Stranded Storm-Kite
stranded_kite.text: Someone's kite is wrapped three times around a spire, fabric still taut with old wind. The frame looks salvageable.

choices.label: Cut it down
choices.result: It comes free all at once and nearly takes you with it. Worth studying, though.

choices.label: Use it as a windbreak
choices.result: You shelter behind it for the night. Simple, and it works.

the_toll_crow.title: The Toll Crow
the_toll_crow.text: A crow the size of a dog watches you from a ledge, head cocked, one leg extended like it's expecting something.

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.result: You leave coin on the ledge. The crow allows you to pass, and drops something in return.

choices.label: Push past
choices.result: It follows you for an hour, shrieking. Exhausting, but free.

quiet_overhang.title: A Quiet Overhang
quiet_overhang.text: The rock bows out overhead just enough to keep the weather off. Old scratch marks in the stone count something — days, maybe, or teeth.

choices.label: Make camp here
choices.result: It is exactly as dry and quiet as it looks.

choices.label: Count the scratches
choices.result: There are more than you're comfortable counting. Tucked into the deepest one, something metal.

scavenger_raid.title: A Scavenger's Raid
scavenger_raid.text: Something quick and clever got into your packs while you slept. It hasn't gone far — you can still see it, working something loose from its teeth.

choices.label: Chase it down (lose a random card)
choices.result: You wrestle back most of what it took. Not all of it.

choices.label: Let it have its prize
choices.result: It bounds off delighted. Whatever it took, you can live without.

quiet_technique.title: A Quiet Afternoon
quiet_technique.text: Nothing threatens you for once. There's time to actually practice a move instead of just surviving with it.

choices.label: Drill the fundamentals (sharpen a random card)
choices.result: One move gets sharper, cleaner, more sure.

choices.label: Rest instead
choices.result: Some days the body needs it more than the technique does.

the_shaken_pitch.title: The Shaken Pitch
the_shaken_pitch.text: The whole face trembles — nothing falling, just a deep shudder passing through the rock, gone before you can name it. Your hands don't trust it again for a while.

choices.label: Push on rattled (gain gold, a Bruised Grip joins each deck)
choices.result: You keep climbing. Every hold after this one gets checked twice, whether it needs it or not — that costs you, quietly, from here on.

choices.label: Stop and let it pass
choices.result: You wait it out, hands flat on the rock, until your grip feels like your own again.

abandoned_apothecary.title: The Abandoned Apothecary
abandoned_apothecary.text: A satchel of corked vials, wedged into a crack, labelled in handwriting neither of you recognises. Most of it is still good.

choices.label: Take the marked vial
choices.result: One is labelled plainly enough to trust. You pocket it.

choices.label: Take the whole satchel
choices.result: You grab everything, unlabelled and all, and sort it out later. Something in there stings on the way past.

the_gambling_crow.title: The Gambling Crow
the_gambling_crow.text: A second crow, bolder than the first, hops along the ledge with its head cocked at your belt. It clearly wants to trade — it just isn't clear for what.

choices.label: Wager a potion
choices.result: It snatches whatever you're carrying and drops something heavier in your palm.

choices.label: Keep your vials
choices.result: It sulks off, unimpressed. You keep climbing, a little rattled by how close it got.

field_medics_kit.title: A Field Medic's Kit
field_medics_kit.text: A canvas roll, lashed shut, still smelling faintly of antiseptic. Whoever carried it this far up knew what they were doing.

choices.label: Take the dressing
choices.result: Clean bandages, sealed and dry. You'll want these later.

choices.label: Sell it at the next camp instead
choices.result: Someone down the trail will pay well for gear this good.

the_wandering_brewer.title: The Wandering Brewer
the_wandering_brewer.text: An old climber with a rack of bottles on their back offers you a taste, unasked. "Good for the nerves," they say, "or the opposite, depending."

choices.label: Take the steady one
choices.result: They hand over something labelled plainly and walk on without another word.

choices.label: Ask for the strong stuff
choices.result: They grin and pour something unlabelled. It hits harder than you expected.
